# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_analytics (Data Source)

Reads a Sentry tunnel's ingress/egress time series.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_analytics" "game" {
  tunnel_id = tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.game.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tunnel_id` (Number) Sentry tunnel id.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) `{ingress: [{value, time}], egress: [...], max}` as normalised JSON — use `jsondecode()`.
